query:
SELECT userid                          AS "userid!",
                   COALESCE(status, '')            AS "status!",
                   COALESCE(manual, false)         AS "manual!",
                   COALESCE(lastactivityat, 0)     AS "lastactivityat!",
                   COALESCE(dndendtime, 0)         AS "dndendtime!",
                   COALESCE(prevstatus, '')        AS "prevstatus!"
              FROM status
             WHERE userid = $1
